subject: Re: Coordination - Demo during Nov/Dec site visit window

Cc: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@novusmed.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Demo week and travel conflict

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for accommodating NovusMed — we were excited to lock in the onsite demo for the week of Dec 6. I need to flag a schedule complication on our side: I have a previously-approved sabbatical and a sequence of field site visits that now overlap that week (Dec 4–11). Tom and I will still be on the engagement, but we won't be available for a full-day onsite slot.

Rather than cancel, would Redwood be open to a staggered approach:
- A 25–30 minute recorded walkthrough covering the platform highlights and the pre-read materials (we'd like that by Dec 1 so our team can watch ahead).
- Two 30-minute live office-hours sessions during the week of Dec 6 targeted at different stakeholder groups (technical and product).
- If possible, a short localized 45-minute session (in-person) with our Boston team on Dec 8 afternoon — that's the only half-day some colleagues will be in town.

We can share an attendee list and the site visit itinerary if that helps. Also, please let us know who from Redwood would be our point person for the in-person 45-minute slot in Boston.

Attaching a quick draft of our internal itinerary (site-visit-itinerary.xlsx) and a one-pager on participant roles.

Apologies for the curveball — happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Emily
Dr. Emily Carter
VP, Clinical Partnerships
NovusMed

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and for the itinerary. Totally understood on the travel/sabbatical overlap. We can absolutely pivot to a staggered plan; two quick options below and we can pick what fits NovusMed best: 

Option A (recommended):
- Deliver a 28-minute narrated walkthrough recording by Dec 1.
- Office-hours #1: 30 mins (technical deep dive) Tue Dec 7 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Office-hours #2: 30 mins (product/ops) Wed Dec 8 2:00–2:30 PM ET
- In-person localized session: Wed Dec 8 3:30–4:15 PM ET (Boston) — Aditya has offered to travel and run this single slot.

Option B (distributed):
- Recording delivered Dec 1
- Two 45-min live sessions on separate days to capture extended Q&A (if preferred by leaders)

To proceed we need: attendee lists for each session, preferred timezone for office-hours, and any focus areas you want in the recording (eg. embeddings+search, batching strategy, security controls). I've attached a short plan that outlines responsibilities and a proposed recording outline (redwood-staggered-plan.pdf).

If Option A looks good I will lock Aditya in for the Boston slot and send calendar invites with three separate items (recording, office-hour 1, office-hour 2 + in-person).
